response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT pt.ID, pt.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS alb, AVG(l.UN * 1.0 / NULLIF(l."T-BIL", 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = l.ID GROUP BY pt.ID, pt.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM s) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - m.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.avg_alb > m.mean_alb

assumptions.assumption: A UN/T-BIL ratio is treated as uncomputable (NULL, ignored in averages) when T-BIL is NULL or 0; UN is multiplied by 1.0 to avoid integer division.
The 'mean of the sex-level ALB averages' is the unweighted mean across sex groups (each sex counts once, regardless of patient count). Sex groups with no ALB values are left out of this mean.
